user_query: I want to analyze the current indie music trends by getting the top 50 indie songs based on their daily stream increase ratio and their metadata.

TaskList.description: Fetch the current data on the top indie songs and their daily streaming statistics.
Filter and sort the songs based on their daily stream increase ratio to get the top 50.
Retrieve detailed metadata for the top 50 songs, including Spotify play counts, song URLs, composer names, ISRC, labels, release dates, genres, Apple IDs, and Spotify IDs.
